model.expr: (sum by (environment, service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[5m]) or rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count{rpc_grpc_status_code=~"2|4|13|14"}[5m])) / sum by (environment, service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) or rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count[5m]))) and (sum by (environment, service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) or rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count[5m])) >= 0.1)

annotations.summary: {{ with $values.A }}API error rate is high: {{ humanizePercentage .Value }} of the requests of {{ $labels.service }} end with an error status.{{ else }}API error rate is high: Grafana cannot query Prometheus.{{ end }}

model.expr: max by (environment, service) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (environment, service, le) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))) or label_replace(histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (environment, service, le) (rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]))), "rpc", "true", "", "")) and (sum by (environment, service) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]) or rate(rpc_server_call_duration_seconds_count[5m])) >= 0.1)

annotations.summary: {{ with $values.A }}API latency is high: the p99 server duration of {{ $labels.service }} is {{ humanizeDuration .Value }}.{{ else }}API latency is high: Grafana cannot query Prometheus.{{ end }}
